deliverables: Instant on-chain distribution of funds to the intended recipient upon enactment
request.recipient: Ikigai Info governance action submitter; specific address or identity not stated in document
request.what: Reimburse the submitter of the Ikigai Info governance action for an unrecovered governance action deposit and estimated lost staking rewards.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 103,000 ADA from the treasury to reimburse a 100,000 ADA lost deposit plus 3,000 ADA for estimated lost staking rewards.
The original Ikigai Info governance action was submitted in September 2024 as a symbolic action thanking contributors and expressing hope for Cardano's future.
The submitter was unable to recover the 100,000 ADA deposit because a Cardano node bug permitted use of an unregistered stake key in the governance action.
The document says there was significant community sentiment at the time that the Ikigai Info governance action deposit should be reimbursed.
The proposal says Cardano in Oceania included the reimbursement in a budget Info governance action, but that governance action was not approved.
The proposal claims the requested amount does not exceed the current Net Change Limit.
The proposal claims the recipient has not previously received treasury funds.
The proposal states there are no costs or expenses associated with the withdrawal and no circumstances under which the withdrawal would be refunded to the treasury.
The proposal states the community can audit the distribution on-chain because funds will be made directly available to the intended recipient.
The proposal provides an external reference to an adastat.net governance action page for the Ikigai action.

summary: The document asks for a 103,000 ADA treasury withdrawal to reimburse a lost governance action deposit and estimated staking rewards, but most key factual predicates are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
